modules.description: The modules to fetch, each pinned to a commit.

module.description: The module's registry-global name: registry, owner and name.

commit.description: The commit to fetch. A BSR commit is immutable, so a pinned fetch is byte-reproducible, which is what lets an offline run replay it from the tree. Left out, `ref` is resolved online and warned about, and refused offline.

ref.description: The label to resolve when there is no commit. Defaults to main.

paths.description: Directories of the module to keep, relative to its root; the rest is left behind. Left out, the whole module.

cache.description: Where the last run's files were written, repo-relative: the same path as the step's out. An offline run replays what is there and checks it against the lock beside it.
